Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Jobomschrijving

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

Jobomschrijving

If you are ambitious, self-motivated, hardworking and a team player and interested in growing your career with an International FMCG business, please read through our job opportunity.

Your responsibilities are
	
• Improve efficiency of filling lines by developing, managing and introducing a variety of improvement actions with as objective to increase productivity and quality of the output of the filling lines. You make an analysis of production processes and report about waste in quality and efficiency.	
• Solve critical issues by analyzing root causes on the short term and make proposals for solutions on the long term in order to guarantee and optimize filling production and this by engaging and motivating team members and let them gain autonomy in their job roles.	
• Check continuously the filling production processes in terms of quality, input, output, safety and ergonomic circumstances	
• Make proposals, together with the production team and the team coordinator, of technical improvements and guarantee that the improvements are implemented with as objective to improve efficiency, quality, lead time and to maintain cost leadership. You make sure the proposals are in line with the operational excellence strategy. You are responsible for the improvement projects, both technical and organizational, from A to Z.	
• Act as back up of the filling production manager in day-to-day activities of the department.

Studies and working experience
	
• Industrial engineering degree without experience or bachelor with experience	
• Experience in a production environment	
• Experience in project management is an asset
Technical skills
	
• Good knowledge of Dutch	
• Knowledge of English / French	
• Knowledge of TPM / Lean / Operational Excellence	
• Knowledge MES system	
• Knowledge MS Office / Excel
Specific skills
	
• Analytic	
• Innovative	
• Communicative skill	
• Setting of priorities	
• Problem analysis

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

Are you accurate, flexible, and do you enjoy working in a clean production environment? For a modern food company in Zottegem, we are looking for packers.

Below is the list of tasks for this position:

• Correctly packaging fine food products according to the established standards. 
• Carrying out quality checks to ensure that every product meets our high standards. 
• Setting up and adjusting machines to guarantee a smooth production process. 
• Working together with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met and customers remain satisfied. 
• As a packer, you make sure our products are perfectly packaged before they are sent to our customers.

• You can speak Dutch or English.
• You can work either from 6h-14h, 14h-22h or 22h-6h. 
• You are at least 3 days a week available to work.
• You can choose which day and shift you wanna work.
• You have experience in a production environment.

For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators

• Forklift drivers

• Loaders and unloaders

• Overhead crane operators

• Saw machine operators

• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.

• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.

• You have solid technical insight.

• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.

• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.

• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.

• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

Our client is looking for a passionate Customer Success Expert to deliver an exceptional customer experience and build long-lasting relationships with customers.

As part of the Customer Success team, you will be responsible for supporting customers throughout their journey, resolving issues efficiently, and continuously improving internal processes to enhance customer satisfaction

Client Details

Our client is a fast-growing and innovative company operating in the urban mobility sector. With a strong focus on technology, design, and customer experience, they are redefining how people move around cities and are continuing to expand their presence across Europe.

Description

• Develop a deep understanding of the company's products and services.
• Support customers and help them get the most value from the solutions offered.
• Act as the voice of the customer and share feedback internally.
• Identify opportunities to improve customer success processes.
• Troubleshoot issues and provide effective solutions.
• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction

• Fluent in English, German,
• Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Customer-oriented, empathetic, and solution-driven.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Team player with a proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership

jobs.occupation: Customer Experience Specialist France - Region Kontich
jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to support and further develop their French-speaking customer base. In this role, you will ensure an outstanding customer journey from order placement to delivery and after-sales support while building long-term customer relationships.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally recognised company, operating within the lifestyle industry. 
With a strong focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, our client has built an excellent reputation in both B2B and B2C markets. To strengthen their customer experience team, they are currently looking for a service-driven professional with a strong affinity for the French market.
 
Company is located in the region of Kontich/Edegem. Easy connection with car & public transport.

 

Description

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the French market (B2B).
• Advise customers on products, collections, and available solutions.
• Handle customer enquiries via phone and email in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
• Process, manage, and follow up on orders within the ERP system.
• Coordinate the order flow and ensure timely delivery to customers.
• Work closely with the sales, logistics, and planning teams to guarantee a seamless customer experience.
• Manage customer complaints and provide effective and customer-focused solutions.
• Support commercial initiatives, quotations, and after-sales activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication, and customer service.
• Contribute actively to customer loyalty and long-term customer relationships.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in customer service, internal sales or customer support.
• Native-level French proficiency.
• Good command of English.
• Strong affinity with French culture and the French market.
• Experience within lifestyle or premium consumer goods sector is considered a strong asset.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for additional sales.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Solution-oriented and able to perform effectively under pressure.
• Excellent communication skills and customer-centric attitude.
• Team player with a proactive mindset.
• Passion for premium-quality products.

jobs.occupation: Risk Advisory Analyst - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international organisation active in the financial services sector. Based in Brussels, they operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment, supporting businesses with complex financial and trade-related challenges.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess credit and insurance applications linked to international transactions
• Conduct financial, qualitative and risk analysis on companies and projects
• Evaluate political, economic and country risks impacting transactions
• Prepare recommendations and propose tailored risk solutions
• Present assessments to internal decision-making committees
• Build relationships with local and international stakeholders
• Contribute to process improvements and internal development initiatives

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law or a related field
• Initial experience in finance, credit analysis, insurance or risk management is a strong asset
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations
• Structured, accurate and able to work independently
• Excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills
